_notes: aliases: runtime-backed method renames. Each entry clones every overload named 'from' on 'class' under the name 'to' (same signature). The aliases exist at runtime; this only teaches the editor.
Both names stay visible (no suppression hooks). If a real method named 'to' with the same erased signature exists, the real one wins and no synthetic is made.
Optional signatures contains Java declarations of 'from' overloads, used when 'from' is absent from the editor classpath. Generated catalogs include these automatically.
hideOriginal is reserved for a future suppression mode; currently informational, both names are shown.
object-overload reads this file too (sibling ../method-aliases/aliases.json) so rewritten Object-signatures are also emitted under alias names.
This file is reloaded automatically when modified; a broken file keeps serving the last good config.
